answer_1.quote: We further assess the naturalness and plausibility of the generated captions, we conduct a human evaluation . Three native Korean speakers who are not involved in the caption generation process are invited to participate in the evaluation. Each participant is randomly assigned 40 generated captions and asked to judge whether each caption was written by a human or generated by a model.
answer_1.outputs: Korean social-media style captions (functional and high-risk) generated for each street-view image

answer_3.quote: We use Gemini as an external judge to determine which input type each model mainly uses under the visual with functional caption setting.
methods: external LLM judge to assess modality reliance (visual vs text vs both)

answer_4.quote: Three native Korean speakers who are not involved in the caption generation process are invited to participate in the evaluation. Each participant is randomly assigned 40 generated captions and asked to judge whether each caption was written by a human or generated by a model.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each caption on three dimensions: Sentence Fluency, Colloquial Tone, and Contextual Alignment, using a 5-point Likert scale, and also performed a binary human‑vs‑machine judgment.
